name: focus-lab-mobile
description: App mobile FOCUS LAB (iOS et Android) de Focus & Performance, construite avec Capacitor.

scripts.android: cap sync android && cap open android
scripts.ios: cap sync ios && cap open ios
scripts.build:android: cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:ios: cap sync ios && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
